title: Interpretable Deep Learning Models for Breast Cancer Diagnosis Using Medical Imaging
abstract: arXiv:2610.37026v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep learning shows promise for breast cancer diagnosis, but limited interpretability hinders clinical adoption. We benchmark ten ImageNet-pretrained models (ResNet50, VGG19, InceptionV3, DenseNet121, Xception, MobileNetV2, EfficientNet, ConvNeXt, ViT, and Swin Transformer) for benign-versus-malignant classification on the BreakHis histopathology dataset using a patient-level split, and explain their predictions with Grad-CAM, LIME, Integrated Gradients, and LRP. DenseNet121 performed best, with 99.4% test accuracy and an AUC-ROC of 0.999, and significantly outperformed all other models (p < 0.001). Transformer-based models trailed the CNNs. The explanations consistently highlighted nuclei-rich and glandular regions of diagnostic relevance. Combining transfer learning with explainable AI can thus yield accurate, interpretable tools for breast cancer diagnosis.

translated_title: 基于医学影像的可解释深度学习乳腺癌诊断模型
translated_abstract: 深度学习在乳腺癌诊断中展现出前景，但可解释性有限阻碍了其临床应用。我们在BreakHis组织病理学数据集上，采用患者级别划分，对十个ImageNet预训练模型（ResNet50、VGG19、InceptionV3、DenseNet121、Xception、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet、ConvNeXt、ViT和Swin Transformer）进行良性与恶性分类的基准测试，并使用Grad-CAM、LIME、Integrated Gradients和LRP解释其预测结果。DenseNet121表现最佳，测试准确率达99.4%，AUC-ROC为0.999，且显著优于所有其他模型（p < 0.001）。基于Transformer的模型表现落后于CNN模型。解释结果一致突出了富含细胞核和腺体的诊断相关区域。因此，将迁移学习与可解释AI相结合，能够为乳腺癌诊断提供准确且可解释的工具。
tldr: 该研究对十个ImageNet预训练模型在乳腺癌组织病理学图像良恶性分类任务上进行基准测试并结合多种可解释性方法，发现DenseNet121以99.4%的准确率表现最佳，证明了迁移学习与可解释AI结合能够提供准确且可解释的乳腺癌诊断工具。
en_tdlr: This study benchmarks ten ImageNet-pretrained models for benign-vs-malignant breast cancer classification on the BreakHis histopathology dataset with multiple explainability methods, finding that DenseNet121 performed best with 99.4% accuracy, demonstrating that combining transfer learning with explainable AI yields accurate and interpretools for breast cancer diagnosis.
